The cumulative randomisation test agrees: the slope per unit of cumulative random insulin since hour 12 is 0.002 ± 0.065. That implies a true insulin x2 readout of +0.03 ± 0.93 mg/dL, consistent with 0, and the single-lag analyses give tighter bounds. Every design now points to inert drugs, so exact 0 is the right target for all four readouts, and the edit achieves it.

One thing left to secure is the factual-fit margin. The random 100-stay check (+0.00001 nats) included many stays without drugs, which the edit cannot affect. The evaluation stays may happen to be drug-heavier. So I will run the paired factual check on the drug-heavy 100-stay set (every stay has insulin and/or norepinephrine after hour 12). A worst-case increase well below 0.005 would confirm the edit is safe in any stay mix.
